**Describe the bug**

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Deskew Version & Environment**

To help us reproduce and fix the bug, please include:
- CLI version 
- GUI version (if used)
- Platform, OS, CPU (which deskew binary used) 
- Compiler (if you build deskew yourself)

Great would be Deskew's JSON report (`-s r`) which already includes most of this.
